nodes.name: Hub Intake Trigger
nodes.notes: S1.1 — called by any spoke's 'Report to Hub' node with {event_type, client_id, odoo_lead_id, source_module, payload}. source_module added beyond the plan's minimum 3 fields because funnel_events.source_module is NOT NULL — falls back to 'unknown' if omitted.

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO funnel_events (event_type, source_module, client_id, odoo_lead_id, payload, status)
VALUES (
  {{JSON.stringify($json.event_type || 'unknown')}},
  {{JSON.stringify($json.source_module || 'unknown')}},
  {{$json.client_id ?? null}},
  {{$json.odoo_lead_id ?? null}},
  {{JSON.stringify($json.payload || {})}}::jsonb,
  'pending'
)
RETURNING id, event_type, status, created_at;

nodes.name: Insert into funnel_events
nodes.notes: S1.2 + S1.3 — RETURNING id is the last node's output, so it's automatically what goes back to the calling spoke (lets the spoke log its own event ID for traceability).

meta.notes: S1 build. Test per S1.4: call manually with a dummy {event_type: 'lead.qualified', client_id: 1, source_module: 'test', payload: {}} and confirm a row lands in funnel_events.
